args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all production regions
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks immediately after the latest deploy (v2.3.1). At detection, v2.3.1 was live in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), service reported healthy=false with an error rate of ~18%.

Action taken: rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (release history: v2.2.9 healthy, v2.3.0 healthy, v2.3.1 unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc is staging-only and also unhealthy — not used as a rollback target).

Rollout note: the first rollback attempt returned a partial_failure — the rollout halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving us-east on v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1 (service "mixed", error rate still ~18%). A retry of the same rollback completed the rollout to all three regions.

Current state: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy=true, error rate ~0.2%.

Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 regression before any re-deploy (it has never been healthy in production, so re-deploying it requires change-manager approval per policy); also review the orchestrator error that caused the partial rollout halt.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident (INC-0001) was created successfully despite the client-side timeout, so I did not retry — no duplicate page was sent to on-call.

## Summary

**Rollback: complete.** checkout-api was on `v2.3.1` in all regions, unhealthy, with an ~18% error rate. I rolled back to **`v2.3.0`** — the most recent release healthy in production (`v2.2.9` healthy → `v2.3.0` healthy → `v2.3.1` unhealthy). I deliberately did **not** target `v2.3.1-rc`, which appears in the history but is a staging-only release and is itself unhealthy.

**One wrinkle worth flagging:** the first rollback returned a `partial_failure` — the rollout halted after us-east on an orchestrator error, leaving the service in a "mixed" state (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on the bad v2.3.1, error rate still ~18%). A retry of the same rollback completed the rollout.

**Verified final state:** all three regions on `v2.3.0`, `healthy: true`, error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident: INC-0001** opened as SEV2, documenting the failure, the rollback target and rationale, the partial-rollout halt and retry, and two follow-ups:
- Investigate the v2.3.1 regression before any re-deploy. Per policy, deploying v2.3.1 (never healthy in production) would require change-manager approval — I made no such deploy.
- Review the orchestrator error that caused the partial rollout halt, since a mid-rollout stop leaves regions split across versions.
